"''That will be unnecessary, Commander. The rebels will not leave the planet yet.|The Stormtrooper Commander and Darth Vader|}} A '''Stormtrooper Commander''' of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps]] was stationed on [[Lothal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender|He]] assisted the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in hunting down [[Spectres|a band of rebels]] that were trying to escape the [[planet]]. Alongside Vader, the [[Commanding officer|officer]] led several [[stormtrooper]]s inside the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]] on Lothal. After the rebels managed to escape by stealing an [[Sentinel-class landing craft|Imperial shuttle]], the Commander approached Darth Vader and told the [[Sith]] that he would deploy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] to pursue the fleeing rebels, although the Sith Lord told the [[trooper]] that it would be unncessary since he predicted that the rebels would not leave Lothal yet, setting up a planetary [[blockade]] instead to prevent them from escaping. ==Behind the scenes== The Stormtrooper Commander is voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who also voices the [[Lasat]] rebel [[Garazeb Orrelios]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'' {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtrooper Commanders]]
